_comment: Few-shot examples for the Sales node's intent prompt (plan section 8). Loaded by com.hivecore.llm.FewShots.

Shape: {role, shots:[{question, answer}]}. answer is an IntentSet object: {intents:[{table, metric, column?, group_by?, filters?}]} or {not_relevant:true}, optionally led by "skip" (measures that belong to another node; the parser ignores the key).
Each shot becomes a user turn (the question) and an assistant turn (the answer re-encoded compactly, key order kept). Keep exactly three; mined rows are added at runtime by the evening close.

Shot 2 shows a single month value (YYYY-MM). Shot 3 shows the coverage rule on a two-part question (reps are HR's, so skip them; only units) and a period range (last quarter = 2026-07..2026-09 in the demo year). Placed last, measured on the NPU (Wave 4): the Q1 sentence then ends after one intent (68 tokens) instead of adding a rep count (121 tokens, past the 4.5 s budget).

shots.question: How many employees do we have?
Revenue in March in the West
Units sold per region last quarter, and how many reps per region?
